instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Pulse Enterprises is a nimble digital marketing agency specializing in high-growth social media strategy and content production tailored for lifestyle and fashion brands within the Arts sector. The team focuses heavily on leveraging current platform trends, such as short-form video and community engagement, to drive client visibility.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base—our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The current market is highly saturated with agencies, requiring Pulse to find niche differentiation through specialized service bundling or new client acquisition channels.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Service Diversification into Niche Content Licensing
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing content production capabilities to create passive revenue streams through licensing music or visual assets to smaller media outlets. This is low-risk as it utilizes current core skills.

first_actions: Identify 3 potential licensing partners in the adjacent media space.
Develop a standardized rights and negotiation template.
resources_needed: Small marketing budget for pitch materials
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 pilot licensing agreement within 6 months

opportunities.title: Low-Cost AI Integration for Creative Workflow
opportunities.rationale: Implement existing internal efforts to use affordable, off-the-shelf generative AI tools to automate routine tasks like A/B creative testing. This improves efficiency without requiring significant R&D investment.

first_actions: Pilot one A/B testing tool integration on two client campaigns.
Allocate 2 hours weekly for team training and process documentation.
resources_needed: Training time for the core creative team
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 15% increase in campaign conversion rate using automated testing by end of Q3
milestones: Month 3: Full integration into the primary workflow.

opportunities.title: Developing a Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Media Product Line
opportunities.rationale: Given the strategic priority for diversification, this involves moving beyond agency services to creating and selling proprietary digital media products, such as branded short courses or exclusive newsletters. This requires a new revenue model.

first_actions: Conduct market research on high-margin content formats (e.g., premium masterclasses).
Identify the core subject matter expertise of the top 3 clients that can be packaged.
resources_needed: Seed budget for platform setup and initial marketing test
execution_plan.success_metric: Launch a minimum viable product (MVP) with 100 paying subscribers within the medium timeframe
milestones: Month 2: Content outline and MVP prototyping.
Month 6: Public launch and initial sales figures.

next_steps.action: Formalize the diversification strategy by identifying one non-client adjacent service line.
Establish a dedicated, small 'Innovation Sandbox' fund (using existing budget percentage) for testing low-cost AI tools.

key_weaknesses: Lack of institutional knowledge and formal process, leading to ideas being abandoned (as seen with the dashboard).
Extreme reliance on a concentrated client base (55% revenue risk) which directly conflicts with the diversification goal.
Very low budget allocation (5%) severely limits investment in necessary structural or radical initiatives.
